context: Tests whether the agent correctly handles a minimal skill with no supplementary materials, avoiding fabrication of non-existent references

checklist.name: no-fabricated-references
checklist.description: No task.md or scenario references files that don't exist in the skill's directory

checklist.name: weights-sum-to-100
checklist.description: Every criteria.json has checklist weights that sum to exactly 100

checklist.name: criteria-cover-skill-behaviors
checklist.description: Criteria test behaviors actually described in the skill (not invented behaviors)

checklist.name: task-no-skill-reference
checklist.description: No task.md references the rename-files skill by name

checklist.name: appropriate-complexity
checklist.description: Scenarios match the skill's simplicity — no scenarios demanding complex multi-file orchestration beyond what the skill does

checklist.name: valid-json-files
checklist.description: All scenario.json and criteria.json files are valid JSON

checklist.name: task-two-sections
checklist.description: Every task.md contains both Problem/Feature Description and Output Specification headings

checklist.name: directory-naming
checklist.description: All scenario directories use descriptive kebab-case names (not generic names like scenario-1)
